title: A cinema ticket price
description:
Work out a ticket price from the age and the day.

```
Age: 15
Day (mon-sun): tue
Ticket: 4.50
```

starter.main.py:
age = int(input("Age: "))
day = input("Day (mon-sun): ")

# TODO: refuse a negative age

# TODO: pick the price with if / elif / else

# TODO: the Tuesday discount

print(f"Ticket: {0:.2f}")

hints: Check the ranges from one end to the other so each `elif` only needs one comparison: `if age < 12`, `elif age < 18`, `elif age < 65`, `else`.
`day.lower() == "tue"` ignores the case. `max(price - 2, 3)` keeps the discount from going below 3.00.
requirements: Children under 12 pay 4.00, teenagers (12 to 17) pay 6.50, adults pay 9.00 and people 65 or older pay 5.50.
On Tuesday (`tue`) every ticket is 2.00 cheaper, but never below 3.00.
A negative age prints `Not a valid age` and nothing else.
Accept the day in any case (`TUE`, `Tue`).
stretch: Ask how many tickets and print the total, with a 10% discount for groups of 5 or more.
